args.command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== SERVICES ==='; for u in zen-openchatx zen-ops-worker zen-ops-results zen-ops-funnel; do printf '%s active=' "$u"; systemctl is-active "$u" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s enabled=' "$u"; systemctl is-enabled "$u" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '=== PORTS ==='; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(18001|18080|18789|18991|8876|8877)\\b' || true; echo '=== PROCESSES ==='; ps -eo pid,etime,user,args | grep -Ei 'openchatx|openclaw' | grep -v grep || true; echo '=== OPENCHATX PATHS ==='; for p in /opt/zen/tools/openchatx-linux-sandbox /var/lib/zen-openchatx /var/lib/zen-ops/work/openchatx-linux-probe; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then echo PRESENT:$p; else echo MISSING:$p; fi; done
